title: Boardwalk section 3 closed for new decking
summary: The last 400 feet of boardwalk before the Wallow are closed while the new decking goes in. Use the Wallow Loop to reach the inlet.
body: The last 400 feet of boardwalk before the Wallow are closed while the new decking goes in. Use the Wallow Loop to reach the inlet.

title: Wet leaves and slick switchbacks
summary: Leaves cover the rock steps below the overlook. Wear shoes with grip and take the switchbacks slowly.
body: Leaves cover the rock steps below the overlook. Wear shoes with grip and take the switchbacks slowly.

title: No ice activities on the Wallow
until: Posted when ice is 5 in thick
summary: The Wallow is not frozen. Skating opens only when the crew measure 5 inches of clear ice and post it here.
body: The Wallow is not frozen. Skating opens only when the crew measure 5 inches of clear ice and post it here.

title: Splash Pad closed for the season
summary: The pad is drained and winterized. It reopens in June.
body: The pad is drained and winterized. It reopens in June.

title: Wallow Loop open, leaf collection on weekdays
summary: Leaf blowers and a collection truck work the loop on weekday mornings. Expect short stops.
body: Leaf blowers and a collection truck work the loop on weekday mornings. Expect short stops.

title: Meadow Restrooms winterized
summary: Use the heated South Restrooms by the playground.
body: Use the heated South Restrooms by the playground.

title: Perimeter Path open
summary: All 4.2 miles open. Plowed first after snow.
body: All 4.2 miles open. Plowed first after snow.
